items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，据彭博社今天（31 日）凌晨报道，AI 基础设施建设仍将吸引巨额资金。Alphabet、Meta、微软、亚马逊和甲骨文五大科技巨头承诺，未来数年将在数据中心等领域投入超过 3 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20.01 万亿元人民币） 。 随着数据中心建设竞赛愈演愈烈，五家公司披露的租赁、建筑、能源及设备采购承诺大幅增长。这些资金有的将在短期内支出，有的则涉及 未来数十年的长期合同 。 谷歌的支出承诺规模最大。根据 Alphabet 提交的监管文件，包括技术设备、能源和租赁在内的合同承诺总额 超过 1 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 6.67 万亿元人民币） ， 接近一年前的八倍 。 Meta 的支出承诺同样大幅攀升，未来支出总额 超过 8,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.34 万亿元人民币） 。其中将近一半用于尚未生效的数据中心租约，最长分 30 年支付。Meta CFO 苏珊 · 李在上周的分析师电话会议上说：“我们预计将继续大举投资，支持核心业务和新兴 AI 项目。” 今年商界的一大争论，是科技企业斥资数千亿美元建设 AI 数据中心， 究竟能否收回投资 。Alphabet 和 Meta 都是全球最赚钱的企业之一，却因投资有望改变行业格局的新业务，出现 自由现金流由正转负 的情况。 不过，五家公司的支出并非全部用于数据中心，披露口径也不完全一致，…
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle have committed more than $3 trillion to data centers and related infrastructure over the coming years. Alphabet's contractual commitments exceed $1 trillion, nearly eight times a year earlier, while Meta's future spending tops $800 billion, with nearly half tied to data-center leases extending up to 30 years. The commitments raise questions over whether massive AI infrastructure spending will pay off.

items.why_en: More than $3 trillion in infrastructure commitments highlights the scale of the AI compute race and heightens concerns about returns on investment.

items.summary_en: Data from QUICK FactSet shows the five major memory chip makers—Kioxia, Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron and SanDisk—posted combined operating profit of 32 trillion yen in the latest quarter, about 10 times year-ago levels, surpassing the combined profits of Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta and Apple for the first time. The AI investment boom has driven memory demand and supply shortages; Kioxia's quarterly net profit exceeded 1 trillion yen for the first time.

items.title_zh: 西湖大学成立世界模型研究中心，致力于突破核心瓶颈
items.title_en: Westlake University Establishes World Model Research Center
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，10 月 31 日，西湖世界模型研究中心在西湖大学云谷校区成立。这是西湖大学面向物理智能领域设立的校级交叉科研平台。 该中心由西湖大学工学院博士生导师、助理教授，人工智能企业 KMind 联合创始人兼首席科学家于开丞担任主任，由西湖大学人工智能讲席教授、人工智能系系主任金耀初担任首席科学家，并有多位 PI （首席研究员）共同承担各方向研究任务。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，中心面向人工智能从语言认知走向物理交互的发展方向，聚焦世界模型与物理智能， 致力于突破智能系统理解物理规律、预测环境变化和开展交互决策的核心瓶颈 ，打造具有国际引领性的物理智能学术高地与创新引擎。 中心以世界模型为核心研究方向，探索感知、认知、预测与行动相结合的智能体系，推动人工智能在真实环境中形成理解世界、推演未来与自主行动的能力。依托西湖大学的科研基础与交叉学科优势，中心将汇聚多领域研究力量，促进基础理论、关键技术与应用探索协同发展，研发能够理解物理规律、预测行动后果并在真实反馈中持续学习的通用世界模型，支撑我国在新一代人工智能领域的自主创新与前沿布局。
items.summary_en: Westlake University launched the Westlake World Model Research Center on Oct 31 as a cross-disciplinary platform focused on physical intelligence. Led by Yu Kaicheng and chief scientist Jin Yaochu, the center aims to tackle bottlenecks in AI systems' understanding of physical laws, environmental prediction and interactive decision-making, and to develop general world models that learn from real-world feedback.
items.why_zh: 世界模型被视为 AI 从语言认知走向物理交互的关键方向，该中心有助于补齐物理智能领域的基础研究布局。
items.why_en: World models are seen as key to moving AI from language cognition to physical interaction, and the center strengthens foundational research in physical intelligence.

items.summary_en: Blackstone has told investors that Anthropic may not secure an investment-grade credit rating after its IPO, with major agencies more likely to assign a higher speculative-grade rating, according to the Financial Times. The shift could make it harder for Anthropic to borrow cheaply for AI infrastructure; the company is pursuing a $63 billion chip financing deal and plans more than $800 billion in compute infrastructure spending through 2045.
items.why_zh: 信用评级直接影响 Anthropic 巨额 AI 基建融资的成本，也反映市场对 AI 公司高投入模式的风险定价。

items.title_zh: 评估大语言模型的因果推理：程序化生成挑战的案例研究
items.title_en: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in LLMs: A Case Study in the Challenges of Procedural Generation

items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38100v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) appear to represent and reason about a large range of phenomena. In particular, recent studies have examined whether LLMs can accurately reason about causation. One of the most commonly used benchmarks for evaluating formal causal reasoning in LLMs is CLadder, a framework for procedural generation of benchmark data sets that was released in 2023. Experiments with CLadder appear to indicate that LLMs can perform formal causal reasoning in a large percentage of generated examples. In this paper, we examine what can be r…
items.why_zh: 评测数据的生成方式可能决定结论，LLM 的因果推理能力需要更审慎的基准验证。
items.why_en: Benchmark generation choices can shape conclusions, so claims about LLM causal reasoning need more careful validation.

items.title_zh: 不止是捏造：AI 研究代理论文中的数字误归因
items.title_en: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文关注 AI 研究代理撰写论文中的“数字误归因”问题：问题不只是凭空捏造，还包括把数字错误地归到不恰当的来源或语境。作者指出，近期基准显示许多代理撰写的论文未通过诚信检查，但单个 LLM 评审往往只给出失败判定，不解释失败性质；现有检查也多只测内部一致性，或只看数值是否出现在代理输出中。论文重新分析某公开基准全部 540 条已发布判定，覆盖九个代理和十五个开放研究问题，以更细致地理解这类错误。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open research p…
items.why_zh: AI 研究代理进入论文写作流程后，核查数字来源与归因比单纯查重或查捏造更复杂。
items.why_en: As AI research agents enter paper writing, verifying numerical provenance and attribution becomes more complex than simple fabrication checks.

items.title_zh: 更多规划反而有害：面向世界模型的学习型规划器

The comparison planners perform as follows: Selected Adam (7 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 218.440s), adapted iCEM (2 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 49.309s), released LePlanner (16 tasks solved, total planning and encoding time 5.652s). The total planning and encoding time for our action updater is 59.079s. Note that our action updater does not satisfy the task-cost criterion we fixed before ev…
items.why_zh: 规划步数或复杂度增加不等于性能提升，学习型规划器需同时优化成功率与计算成本。
items.why_en: More planning does not guarantee better performance; learned planners must optimize success and compute cost together.

But he has no intention of stopping - and hints there could be much more to come from the company's stockpile of discoveries. "I think, on net, the world deserves to understand how the universe works," Altman said during an episode of the Cheeky Pint podcast released Thursday. "But I do have empathy for the method." His comments mark one of the first times the OpenAI chief has directly acknowledged the company…

items.why_zh: 股东名单显示互联网巨头、产业资本与国资共同入局，可能为 DeepSeek 带来算力、终端与政策资源的协同。
items.why_en: The investor mix of internet giants, industrial capital and state funds could give DeepSeek synergies in compute, devices and policy access.

items.title_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！

items.summary_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！ 搜狐网
items.summary_en: 01.AI has raised hundreds of millions of yuan and plans to move to DeepSeek's home base, according to reports. The move raises questions about talent flows and collaboration among China's LLM startups.
items.why_zh: 在头部公司巨额融资之际，中小AI公司寻求资金与区位协同，反映行业整合加速。
items.why_en: As top players raise mega-rounds, smaller AI firms seek capital and location synergies, signaling accelerating consolidation.

items.title_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！
items.title_en: 01.AI Raises Hundreds of Millions of Yuan, Reportedly Moving to DeepSeek’s Base
items.summary_zh: 融资数亿元，零一万物要搬去DeepSeek大本营了！ 智东西
items.summary_en: Chinese tech media outlet Zhidongxi reports that AI startup 01.AI has raised hundreds of millions of yuan and is reportedly moving to DeepSeek’s base. The report did not disclose the full investor list or valuation. If the move happens, it could bring 01.AI closer to DeepSeek’s ecosystem and intensify regional LLM competition.
items.why_zh: 在行业洗牌期，融资与靠近头部玩家反映二线大模型公司的求生与重组策略。
items.why_en: Amid an industry shakeout, new funding and proximity to a leading player reflect second-tier LLM companies’ survival and restructuring strategies.

items.title_zh: 黑石预计Anthropic IPO后将获“高收益垃圾级”信用评级
items.title_en: Blackstone now expects Anthropic to get a 'high junk' credit rating after its IPO
items.summary_zh: 据 Dealroom 报道，黑石（Blackstone）方面表示，预计 Anthropic 在完成 IPO 后将获得“高收益垃圾级”（high junk）信用评级，即处于投机级但相对靠上的档位。这一判断反映出市场对这家 AI 公司信用状况与资本结构的评估视角。报道未披露具体评级机构、时间表或评级理由的更多细节。对高速烧钱的 AI 实验室而言，上市后的信用评级将直接影响其债务融资成本。
items.summary_en: Blackstone now expects Anthropic to get a 'high junk' credit rating after its IPO Dealroom
items.why_zh: 信用评级直接决定 AI 实验室上市后的债务融资成本，也折射市场对高投入 AI 企业财务稳健性的判断。
items.why_en: A credit rating shapes AI labs' post-IPO borrowing costs and signals how markets judge the financial resilience of high-burn AI firms.

items.title_zh: 国会候选人就AI监管表态
items.title_en: Dick Spotswood: Congressional candidates weigh in on AI regulation
items.summary_zh: 《马林独立报》专栏作者Dick Spotswood撰文称，国会候选人就AI监管议题表达立场。报道未在摘要中给出候选人的具体政策主张或法案细节，但显示AI治理正进入选区政治讨论。随着AI应用扩散，监管路径、隐私与安全等问题可能影响选民态度。
items.summary_en: Dick Spotswood: Congressional candidates weigh in on AI regulation Marin Independent Journal
items.why_zh: AI监管正从技术议题变为选举政治议题，可能影响候选人的政策议程。
items.why_en: AI regulation is shifting from a tech issue to electoral politics, potentially shaping candidates’ policy agendas.

items.title_zh: OpenAI下调融资目标，最新一轮拟募资至多200亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round
items.summary_zh: 据 CNBC 报道，OpenAI 下调了本轮融资的目标，目前计划募集至多 200 亿美元，低于此前的预期规模。报道未详细说明下调的具体原因，但这一调整发生在 AI 行业资本开支高企、投资者对回报周期更为审慎的背景之下。募资规模的变化可能影响 OpenAI 在算力、数据中心与人才上的投入节奏。作为行业龙头，其融资动向也被视为 AI 投资热度的重要风向标。
items.summary_en: OpenAI pares fundraising goal, now seeking up to $20 billion in latest round CNBC
items.why_zh: OpenAI 是全球 AI 投资的风向标，其下调募资目标可能折射投资者对高额资本开支回报周期的审慎态度。
items.why_en: OpenAI is a bellwether for AI investment, and trimming its target may reflect growing investor caution over the payback period for massive capex.

items.title_zh: 阿尔巴尼斯选区艺术家反对AI“选择退出”模式
items.title_en: Artists from Albanese’s district oppose AI opt-out model — The Guardian
items.summary_zh: 据《卫报》报道，来自澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯所在选区的艺术家公开反对AI版权政策中的“选择退出”（opt-out）模式。该模式通常意味着作品默认可被用于AI训练，权利人需主动声明退出；艺术家担忧自身权益受损。报道将这一反对声音置于AI训练数据与版权保护的争论中，可能加大政策制定压力。
items.summary_en: Artists from Albanese’s district oppose AI opt-out model — The Guardian UA.NEWS
items.why_zh: 艺术家群体的反对凸显AI训练数据版权规则仍具争议，可能影响政策走向。
items.why_en: Artist opposition underscores continuing disputes over copyright rules for AI training data and could influence policy.

items.title_zh: 纽约州律师协会发布详细指南，规范律师合乎伦理地使用AI
items.title_en: NYSBA Releases In-Depth Guidelines To Advise Attorneys on Ethical Use of AI
items.summary_zh: 据纽约州律师协会（NYSBA）消息，该协会发布了详细指南，就律师在执业中合乎伦理地使用人工智能提供建议。指南面向法律实务中的 AI 应用场景，帮助律师在采用相关工具时对照职业伦理要求。报道未逐一列出指南的具体条款内容。随着生成式 AI 进入律所日常文书与研究流程，此类行业规范有助于厘清保密义务、能力胜任与监督责任等边界。
items.summary_en: NYSBA Releases In-Depth Guidelines To Advise Attorneys on Ethical Use of AI New York State Bar Association
items.why_zh: 生成式 AI 正进入律所核心工作流程，行业伦理指南有助于明确保密、胜任与监督责任的边界。
items.why_en: As generative AI enters core legal workflows, ethics guidance helps clarify boundaries around confidentiality, competence and supervision.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO面临风险：AI市场回调与高估值担忧
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Faces Risks Amid AI Market Downturn and High Valuation Concerns
items.summary_zh: 围绕Anthropic IPO的讨论升温，有报道称其上市面临风险：AI市场出现回调，估值高企引发担忧。文章将市场环境与公司高估值列为潜在压力，但摘要未披露具体估值、时间表或发行细节。若市场情绪继续走弱，IPO窗口和定价可能受到影响。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Faces Risks Amid AI Market Downturn and High Valuation Concerns KuCoin
items.why_zh: Anthropic的上市进展将成为检验AI高估值与公开市场承受力的关键风向标。
items.why_en: Anthropic’s IPO progress will be a key test of AI valuations and public-market appetite.

items.title_zh: GPT-5.6 Sol 据称可在和平模式下通关《Factorio》
items.title_en: GPT-5.6 Sol can beat Factorio on peaceful mode
items.summary_zh: 一篇发布在 ryanmadden.net 的博客文章声称，模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 能够在和平模式下击败（即完成）工厂建造游戏《Factorio》。该文在 Hacker News 上引发讨论，获得约 130 分、133 条评论，说明社区对 AI 能否胜任这类需要长期规划与资源管理的复杂游戏颇感兴趣。原文未在摘要中给出具体的通关细节、耗时或测试方法，相关论证需参阅文章全文。

items.why_zh: 若属实，这类需要长期规划与自动化设计的游戏通关，将成为检验 AI 长程推理与智能体能力的标志性案例。
items.why_en: If accurate, clearing a game that demands long-horizon planning and automation design would be a notable benchmark for AI reasoning and agent capabilities.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO风险升温：AI泡沫担忧未散，Blackstone发出警告
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Faces Real Risk as AI Bubble Fears Linger and Blackstone Sounds a Warning
items.summary_zh: 有报道称，Anthropic IPO面临现实风险，原因包括AI泡沫担忧挥之不去，以及Blackstone发出警告。文章将高估值与市场情绪视为上市的不确定因素，但未在摘要中给出具体发行规模或估值数据。若风险偏好下降，Anthropic的上市定价与投资者认购可能承压。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Faces Real Risk as AI Bubble Fears Linger and Blackstone Sounds a Warning Benzinga
items.why_zh: Blackstone等机构的市场警告，可能影响投资者对Anthropic及AI资产的风险定价。
items.why_en: Warnings from firms such as Blackstone could affect how investors price risk for Anthropic and AI assets.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO 招股书：一个亮眼数字与一个令人失望的数字
items.title_en: 1 Great Number From Anthropic's IPO Prospectus and 1 Number That Disappointed
items.summary_zh: Motley Fool 撰文解读 Anthropic 首次公开募股（IPO）招股书中的关键数据，从中挑出一个表现亮眼的数字和一个令人失望的数字进行对比分析。文章的关注点在于：透过招股书披露的指标，投资者可以更清楚地看到这家 Claude 开发商在高速增长与成本压力之间的真实处境。由于摘要信息有限，具体数值需参阅原文，但这一视角提示市场正以财务审视的眼光看待头部 AI 公司的上市进程。
items.summary_en: 1 Great Number From Anthropic's IPO Prospectus and 1 Number That Disappointed The Motley Fool

items.why_en: Anthropic's IPO will be a key bellwether for AI valuations and commercialization.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 下调融资目标至 200 亿美元，估值降至 1.25 万亿美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Slashes Funding Target to $20 Billion, Cuts Valuation to $1.25 Trillion: 7 outlets compared
items.summary_zh: 据多家媒体报道，OpenAI 将其融资目标下调至 200 亿美元，同时把公司估值从此前讨论的水平调低至 1.25 万亿美元。NewsCord 汇总并对比了 7 家媒体对这一消息的报道口径，显示各家在融资规模、估值调整幅度及背后原因上的描述存在差异。这一调整被视为市场对 AI 基础设施巨额投入与回报周期重新定价的信号，也让外界更加关注 OpenAI 后续的资金安排与算力扩张计划。
items.summary_en: OpenAI Slashes Funding Target to $20 Billion, Cuts Valuation to $1.25 Trillion: 7 outlets compared NewsCord
items.why_zh: 估值与融资目标双双下调，反映资本市场对 AI 巨头烧钱模式的审慎态度。
items.why_en: Lower funding and valuation targets signal growing investor caution about AI's capital-intensive economics.

items.title_zh: ONLYOFFICE 10.0 发布：开源办公套件加入 AI 工具、模块化应用与更强安全
items.title_en: ONLYOFFICE 10.0 Brings AI Tools, Modular Apps, and Stronger Security to Its Open-Source Office Suite
items.summary_zh: ONLYOFFICE 发布 10.0 版本，为其开源办公套件引入 AI 辅助工具、模块化应用设计以及更强的安全能力。此次更新的定位是让用户在不脱离自托管或私有部署环境的前提下，也能用上智能化的文档处理功能，并通过模块化结构提升部署灵活度。对企业与教育机构用户而言，这进一步缩小了开源办公套件与主流商业办公软件在智能功能上的差距。
items.summary_en: ONLYOFFICE 10.0 Brings AI Tools, Modular Apps, and Stronger Security to Its Open-Source Office Suite markets.businessinsider.com
items.why_zh: 开源办公套件补齐 AI 能力，为企业用户提供了商业套件之外的自托管选择。
items.why_en: AI features in an open-source suite give enterprises a self-hosted alternative to commercial productivity tools.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 禁止用 Claude 克隆游戏与逆向工程
items.title_en: Anthropic Bans AI Game Clones and Reverse Engineering With Claude
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 更新了 Claude 的使用规范，明确禁止利用该模型克隆现有游戏作品或进行逆向工程等行为。这一限制针对的是借助 AI 快速复制他人游戏玩法、素材或代码的灰色操作，意在约束模型被用于侵犯知识产权或规避技术保护的场景。此举延续了头部模型厂商收紧使用条款的趋势，也意味着开发者在使用 Claude 时需要更谨慎地界定其用途边界。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Bans AI Game Clones and Reverse Engineering With Claude TechPowerUp
items.why_zh: 模型厂商正通过使用条款划定知识产权红线，影响开发者的合规边界。
items.why_en: Usage policies are becoming the frontline for enforcing IP boundaries in AI-assisted development.

items.title_zh: 赶在 Meta 之前，我用 50 美元做出了自己的 AI 电子宠物
items.title_en: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.summary_zh: Meta 推出主打可爱形象的 AI 助手产品 Muse Charm，希望像 Tamagotchi 一样让人随身携带一个“有表情”的 AI 伙伴，并在假日季推向市场。本文作者表示不打算购买，而是花约 50 美元自行动手做了一个版本。这个自制设备没有摄像头和 5G 蜂窝模块，但确实能与 Muse 对话、拥有可爱头像，还能兼作怀表与远程取景器，理论上甚至能控制智能家居。作者认为这次动手实践的学习价值远超这 50 美元。
items.summary_en: Mark Zuckerberg's Meta made AI look so stinking cute by giving it a squishy little face - and this holiday season, he wants to sell you a Muse Charm so you can carry your jolly AI helper around like a Tamagotchi. But I won't be buying one, because we have Muse Charm at home . It cost just $50, and I've decided the learning experience was worth it. View Link My version doesn't sport cameras or a 5G cellular radio , but it really talks to Muse and has cute avatars, too! It doubles as a pocket watch and a remote camera viewfinder, and it can (theoretically) control my smart home. Or at least it c…
items.why_zh: 当大厂把 AI 做成消费品硬件时，低成本自制方案展示了 AI 硬件的另一种可能。
items.why_en: A cheap DIY alternative shows how commoditized AI companion hardware is becoming.

items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO: Which Major Investors Will Profit From the ANT Listing? TradingKey

items.why_en: Analyzing IPO beneficiaries reveals Anthropic’s capital structure and whether AI investment returns can be realized in public markets.

items.why_zh: 智能体跨应用执行能力正成为 AI 助手竞争的关键分水岭。

items.why_zh: Agent 架构创新决定了 AI 能否真正从对话走向自主完成任务。
items.why_en: Agent architecture is what determines whether AI can move from conversation to autonomous task completion.

items.why_zh: OpenAI 的估值变动直接影响市场对生成式 AI 投资热潮与企业资本结构的判断。
items.why_en: OpenAI's valuation shift is a key signal for investor sentiment and capital structures across the generative AI boom.

items.title_zh: OPPO Reno17 系列官方爆料：首发 6 秒“全焦段 4K 超清长实况”
items.title_en: OPPO Reno17 Series to Debut 6-Second 'All-Focal 4K Ultra-Clear Live Photos'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，今日，OPPO Reno 系列产品经理张若星分享 Reno17 系列全新样张，并预告新机将搭载“全焦段 4K 超清长实况”，首次将实况时长由原先 3 秒延长至 6 秒。 IT之家注意到，OPPO Reno17 系列手机、Watch 5 手表、Pad Air6 平板于 10 月 30 日开启预约 ，预计将于近期上市。此外，博主 @数码闲聊站 已爆料了 OPPO Reno17 Pro 的部分核心配置： 6.32 英寸 1.5K 分辨率、120Hz 刷新率直屏 联发科天玑 8550 SUPER 处理器 前置摄像头 5000 万像素 后置 2 亿像素大底云台主摄、5000 万像素超广角和 5000 万像素潜望长焦 电池容量预计在 7000mAh 上下 定位“轻薄拍照小屏机”
items.summary_en: OPPO's Reno17 series will debut 'all-focal 4K ultra-clear live photos,' extending live-photo clips from 3 to 6 seconds, according to a product manager's teaser. Pre-orders opened October 30 alongside the Watch 5 and Pad Air6, with leaked Reno17 Pro specs pointing to a Dimensity 8550 SUPER chip and a 200MP gimbal main camera.
items.why_zh: 影像功能仍是国产中高端手机差异化竞争的核心卖点。
items.why_en: Imaging features remain the core differentiator for Chinese mid-to-high-end smartphones.

items.why_en: A leading model developer shifting toward agent architectures could reshape competition as AI moves from chat toward autonomously executing tasks.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent 架构设计：Router 与 Worker 双层架构，探索更自主的 Agent 系统
items.title_en: DeepSeek Explores Super-agent Design With Router and Worker Architecture
items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，DeepSeek Harness 官方团队今日发布《Super-agent 设计探索：迈向更自主的 Agent 系统》一文，介绍了其面向工程实践的 Super-agent 架构设计思路。 随着大模型执行单个任务时越来越不需要人的干预，限制生产力进一步提升的因素正逐渐转向人的注意力，Agent 系统需要从被动响应指令的单任务工具，向持续在线、能够并行处理多项任务的自主协作者演进。 DeepSeek 表示，现有主流 Agent 设计仍以单一 Session（会话）为基本单位，不同 Session 之间相互独立。用户并行推进多项工作时，需要手动切换并维护各个 Session 的上下文。 根据 DeepSeek 团队观察，一个人通常只能同时跟进 3 至 5 个活跃 Session。即使通过 CLI、MCP 或外部连接器扩展本地 Agent，也仍可能面临单会话同步阻塞、多任务上下文混乱，以及本地设备离线后任务停止等问题。 他们将这种新型 Agent 形态及其系统架构称为 Super-agent，并归纳出四项基础特征：连续、高效、主动和持久。 首先，连续意味着用户可以在即时通讯、GitHub 评论等不同渠道与同一个 Agent 交互；高效意味着能够并行处理多个复杂任务；主动意味着系统可以持续观察环境事件并自行推进值得处理的事项；持久则要求 Agent 始终在线…
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness has published a design exploration for a Super-agent architecture aimed at more autonomous agent systems, according to ITHome. It argues that current agents are session-centric, forcing users to manually switch contexts and typically limiting them to 3–5 active sessions, while CLI, MCP, or external connectors still face blocking, context confusion, and offline interruptions. DeepSeek describes the Super-agent as continuous, efficient, proactive, and persistent.
items.why_zh: 该设计直面多会话上下文切换与离线中断等痛点，为更自主的Agent系统提供架构参考。
items.why_en: The design addresses session-switching and offline-interruption pain points, offering an architecture reference for more autonomous agents.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，据路透社报道，10 月最后一个交易日的市场表现相当惨烈，今年以来持续上涨的科技股再次遭遇考验。 当地时间 30 日，纳斯达克综合指数创下 6 月以来最大单日跌幅 。英特尔和社交媒体平台 Reddit 股 价双双下跌 29% ，AI 基础设施投资热潮的重要受益者之一、芯片制造商闪迪也下跌 13%。 这轮抛售发生在 大型科技股本周接连下跌之后 。微软、Meta、亚马逊和谷歌母公司 Alphabet 等 AI 基础设施建设的核心参与者，股价周五 再跌 1% 至 2% ，此前本周早些时候已经出现明显回落。 凯投宏观指出，过去 12 个月，微软、Meta、亚马逊和 Alphabet 四家超大规模科技公司的资本支出，已占到 标普 500 指数现有成分股总资本支出的三分之一以上 。 该机构预计，这一比例还会继续上升，但投资者对这一趋势越来越感到不安。凯投宏观市场经济学家约翰 · 希金斯认为：“巨头的巨额资本支出开始部分依赖外部融资，投资者越来越担心 它们究竟投入了多少钱 ，以及这些投资是通过什么方式筹集资金的。” 纳斯达克 100 指数周五一度跌幅更大， 最终下跌 3.5%，距离较近期高点回落 10% 、进入技术性调整区间也已不远。纳斯达克综合指数则较此前收盘高点下跌 7.8%。10 月成为该指数自 2025 年 3 月以来表现最差的一个月，今年 AI 行情积累…
items.summary_en: On Oct. 30, the Nasdaq Composite posted its biggest one-day drop since June, with Intel and Reddit falling 29% and chipmaker SanDisk down 13%. Microsoft, Meta, Amazon and Alphabet also slipped 1% to 2% amid investor concerns over massive AI infrastructure capex and external financing. The Nasdaq 100 fell 3.5%, nearing correction territory, while October became the Composite's worst month since March 2025.
items.why_zh: 反映市场对AI基础设施巨额投入及其融资方式的担忧正在加剧。
items.why_en: It shows growing investor anxiety over the scale and financing of AI infrastructure spending.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，10 月 31 日，无界动力宣布与京东正式签署战略合作协议，围绕零售场景应用、商业化平台与生态渠道、产业资源协同等多个维度开展立体化合作。 此次合作已迎来首批成果：10 月，双方首个零售合作项目落地， 无界动力机器人 K15 已于七鲜咖啡（西宸里店）和七鲜咖啡（长楹天街店）正式上岗 ；同期，首批机器人产品通过京东平台面向第三方客户完成交付。 在此基础上， 双方将迅速推进 1000+ 七鲜门店的规模化复制 ，并同步深化京东 MALL、京东 RoboBase 等领域的合作。依托京东丰富的线下实体消费场景，双方将围绕门店数字化、智能体验升级与全渠道商品运营持续共建，并重点布局海外市场，共同探索智能零售方案的全球化拓展与商业化落地。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉，在两家七鲜咖啡门店，无界动力具身智能机器人与自动化生产线协作， 从订单触发到任务完成 ，将全流程无人化运行融入门店日常经营。 双方将共同投入技术、产品、市场、供应链及相关资源，以实现 10 亿元人民币 的产品合作规模；深化场景落地、渠道拓展与应用服务的多维度合作，为国际化业务延伸提供机遇与支撑。 延伸阅读 无界动力成立于 2025 年 3 月，总部位于北京，聚焦构建机器人“通用大脑”与“操作智能”，以通用基础模型研发与通用专家模型落地应用双线驱动，致力于为全球客户提供软硬一体、高可靠性的具身智能解决方案…

items.summary_zh: IT之家 10 月 31 日消息，据彭博社报道，全球存储芯片供应短缺问题日益严重之际，今天（31 日）下午，OpenAI CEO 萨姆 · 奥尔特曼在韩国与三星集团高层会面，双方计划进一步加强在存储芯片供应和 AI 基础设施建设方面的合作。 据三星发布的声明，奥尔特曼此次在龙仁市与三星旗下电子、金融和生物科技业务的 约 50 名高管 举行了会谈。双方讨论了未来十年 AI 对产业格局、企业决策方式和商业发展的影响。 多种存储产品供应不足，正在给全球电子行业带来压力，芯片价格也随之大幅上涨。数据中心建设需求持续增长，各大运营商对存储芯片的争夺进一步加剧。AI 基础设施领域的五家头部企业计划在 未来几年投入超过 3 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20.01 万亿元人民币） ，而存储芯片支出约占数据中心 总支出的三分之一 。 报道指出，韩国在先进存储芯片制造领域处于领先地位，AI 技术在当地企业和消费者中的普及也在加快。自去年以来，英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋和 AMD CEO 苏姿丰 分别两度访韩 ，以加强供应链合作。多位科技行业高管此前警告，芯片制造产能难以满足持续增长的市场需求。 此次会面也是双方此前合作计划的延续。按照已公布的合作安排，三星将向 OpenAI 的“星际之门”基础设施项目供应存储芯片，双方还将 共建 AI 数据中心 ，合作范围包括海上浮动式数据中心。与此同时，三星也在…
items.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman met about 50 Samsung executives in Yongin, South Korea, as memory chip shortages intensify, discussing AI's impact over the next decade and deeper cooperation on memory supply and AI infrastructure. Samsung is set to supply memory chips for OpenAI's Stargate project and jointly build AI data centers, including floating offshore facilities.
items.why_zh: 凸显AI算力扩张对存储芯片供应链的依赖，以及科技巨头锁定产能的紧迫性。
items.why_en: It highlights how AI compute expansion depends on memory chip supply and why tech giants are racing to secure capacity.

items.title_zh: V4全系列模型上线后，DeepSeek Harness开发者预览版开放测试
items.title_en: DeepSeek Opens Developer Preview of Harness After V4 Model Series Launch
items.summary_zh: V4全系列模型上线后，DeepSeek Harness开发者预览版开放测试 财联社
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has opened a developer preview of its Harness tooling following the rollout of its full V4 model series, according to Cailian Press. The move signals the company's push beyond model releases into developer tooling and ecosystem building, though technical details remain undisclosed.
items.why_zh: 模型厂商竞争正从单一模型能力转向开发工具与生态，DeepSeek 的动作反映这一趋势。
items.why_en: Competition among model makers is shifting from raw model capability to developer tooling and ecosystems, a trend DeepSeek's move reflects.

items.title_zh: Anthropic IPO对澳大利亚联邦银行的影响
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Impact on Commonwealth Bank of Australia
items.summary_zh: Business Chief 刊文讨论 Anthropic 的 IPO 可能对澳大利亚联邦银行（Commonwealth Bank of Australia）产生的影响。文章将这家 AI 公司上市与澳洲大型银行的业务联系起来，但摘要未给出具体交易规模、时间表或影响细节。该话题反映出金融机构与 AI 公司之间日益紧密的合作与利益关联，正受到商业媒体关注。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Impact on Commonwealth Bank of Australia Business Chief
items.why_zh: AI 公司上市与大型银行的关联，凸显金融业对 AI 供应链与合作伙伴的深度依赖。
items.why_en: The link between an AI listing and a major bank highlights how deeply financial institutions are tied to AI partners.

items.title_zh: 混合记忆架构让长程对话智能体更可靠地记住事实与关系
items.title_en: Long-Term Agent Memory through Complementary Curation and Consolidation
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文提出面向长程对话智能体的混合记忆架构，将“情景记忆”与“结构化关系记忆”结合，并引入整合（consolidation）机制以在扩展记忆的同时保持效率。研究者在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-S 两个基准上做了实证测试，结果显示两类记忆始终呈互补关系，二者组合的系统不仅优于现有最先进的记忆框架，还在指标上达到 90.2 的水平。这项工作说明，单纯堆叠上下文或单一记忆形式难以支撑长期交互，记忆的组织方式与压缩整合同样关键。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39790v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Long-horizon dialogue agents require effective memory systems to recall facts, events, and relationships from interaction histories. In this work, we propose a hybrid-memory architecture comprising episodic memories and structured relational memories and a consolidation mechanism which preserves efficiency. We conduct an empirical study across two benchmarks: LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S. Our experiments demonstrate that the two memory types are consistently complementary, combining both outperform state-of-the-art memory frameworks and achieves 90.2…
items.why_zh: 长期记忆是对话智能体从“一次性问答”走向持续协作的核心瓶颈，该研究给出了可验证的架构方向。
items.why_en: Long-term memory is a core bottleneck for turning chat agents into persistent collaborators, and this work offers a benchmark-validated architectural direction.

items.title_zh: 新数据集用随机抽取的数学猜想检验语言模型真实能力
items.title_en: Beyond Selected Breakthroughs: Evaluating Language Models on Randomly Sampled Mathematical Conjectures
items.summary_zh: 过去一年，前沿语言模型不断给出对长期未解猜想的证明或反例，但仅盯着这些“被选中的突破”会高估模型能力，也无法反映达成结果所需的算力。为此研究者构建了新数据集 OpenConjecture，从 2026 年 2 月以来发表于 arXiv 的数学论文中收集猜想，把它们作为开放数学问题的来源，用随机抽样的方式系统评测语言模型。这一做法旨在避免“挑题偏差”，更完整地刻画模型在真实数学研究场景中的表现与资源开销。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.40382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The last year has seen a shift in AI-assisted mathematics, with frontier language models producing proofs of and counterexamples to long-standing open conjectures. However, studying only the current set of major breakthroughs provides an incomplete picture of LLM capabilities and the computational resources needed to achieve reported results. To address this, we introduce a new dataset, OpenConjecture, which collects conjectures from mathematics papers published on the arXiv since February 2026. We use these conjectures as a source of open mathem…
items.why_zh: 只评测“成功案例”会系统性高估模型能力，随机抽样的猜想评测为 AI 数学研究提供了更可信的基准。
items.why_en: Grading only headline successes systematically inflates perceived capability; randomly sampled conjectures give AI-for-math a more honest benchmark.

items.title_zh: “产物蒸馏”：不训练小模型，也能继承前沿模型的能力
items.title_en: Artifact Distillation: Training-Free Transfer from Frontier to Small Language Models
items.summary_zh: 缩小前沿模型与小模型差距的常规做法是蒸馏：用大模型的输出微调小模型，这使能力迁移绑定在训练算力上，且迁移的知识高度不透明。论文提出“Artifact Distillation（产物蒸馏）”：让教师模型解题并把解题过程外化为一个“产物库”，学生在推理时查询该库，全程无需梯度更新。在四个 LiveBench 任务上，由 Claude Opus 4.5 编写的产物库让小模型获得了性能提升，为低成本能力迁移提供了不依赖再训练的替代路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37680v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Closing the gap between frontier and smaller language models is usually approached by distillation: fine-tuning the small model (student) on a frontier model's (teacher) outputs, which binds transfer to training compute and leaves the transferred knowledge largely opaque. We propose Artifact Distillation: a teacher solves training instances and externalizes its problem-solving procedure into an artifact bank that a student queries at inference time, with no gradient updates. Across four LiveBench tasks, a bank written by Claude Opus 4.5 lets Cl…
items.why_zh: 若能力迁移可以绕开再训练，小模型部署的成本与透明度问题都将被重新定义。
items.why_en: If capability transfer can bypass retraining, the cost and opacity of deploying small models are fundamentally redefined.

items.title_zh: 为列表式偏好加上本地差分隐私，让 LLM 对齐不再泄露用户排序
items.title_en: Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment
items.summary_zh: 列表式偏好反馈比成对比较为大模型对齐提供更丰富的监督信号，但完整排序也会暴露更多敏感的用户偏好。现有隐私保护对齐方法主要针对成对反馈，列表式对齐在本地差分隐私（LDP）下的研究仍是空白。论文指出关键难点：完整排序空间敏感度过高，直接加噪会淹没列表式监督带来的收益，因此提出“排序感知”的机制来缓解这一问题，在保护用户偏好的同时保留可用的对齐信号。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37682v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision. To add…
items.why_zh: 对齐数据往往直接来自真实用户，隐私保护若只覆盖成对比较，列表式反馈就会成为泄露口。
items.why_en: Alignment data comes from real users, so privacy guarantees that cover only pairwise feedback leave listwise preferences as a leakage channel.

items.title_zh: 用魔术表演考视觉模型：《The Prestige》基准揭示与人类的推理差距
items.title_en: The Prestige: Benchmarking Cognitive Visual Reasoning using Magic Tricks
items.summary_zh: 研究者推出视频理解基准 The Prestige，用专业魔术表演来探测模型的认知视觉推理能力：魔术中的刻意误导要求模型跟踪事件线索，并解释看似意外的结果。基准包含开放式问题，覆盖时间与因果理解，以及对对抗性提问的鲁棒性。评测结果显示，即便是最强的开源与商用视觉语言模型，与人类表现之间仍存在明显差距，作者还发现了不同模型之间的系统性偏差。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce The Prestige, a video understanding benchmark that probes cognitive visual reasoning through professional magic performances, where deliberate misdirection challenges models to track events and explain unexpected outcomes. The benchmark comprises open-ended questions ranging from temporal and causal understanding to robustness against adversarial questions. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary VLMs reveals a substantial gap between even the strongest model and human performance. We also find systematic discrepancies be…
items.why_zh: 魔术把“被误导时还能否正确推理”变成可测量的测试，暴露了当前多模态模型在因果与注意力控制上的短板。
items.why_en: Magic turns resistance to misdirection into a measurable test, exposing current multimodal models' weaknesses in causal reasoning and attentional control.

items.title_zh: 新数据集公开 GPU 秒级功耗曲线，揭示 AI 算力的电力波动
items.title_en: LLM-PowerTrace: A Dataset of Time-Resolved GPU Power Traces for AI Compute
items.summary_zh: AI 算力正成为规模庞大且快速变化的电力负载，其对数据中心基础设施与电网的影响不仅取决于总能耗，还取决于功耗在亚秒到分钟尺度上的变化，包括峰值、爬坡以及多张加速卡之间的同步波动。现有大模型能耗基准通常只报告“每 token 焦耳”等汇总指标，很少公开底层时间序列。论文发布 LLM-PowerTrace 数据集，提供时间分辨的 GPU 功耗轨迹，填补这一数据空白。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38315v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI compute is becoming large and fast-changing electrical loads. Its impacts on data center infrastructure and power grids depend not only on total energy consumption, but also on how their power draw moves over sub-second to minute timescales, including peaks, ramps, and synchronized fluctuations across accelerators. Existing energy benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) report aggregate quantities such as joules per token and rarely release the underlying time-series measurements, leaving these power dynamics poorly characterized and dif…
items.why_zh: 电网与数据中心规划需要秒级功耗数据，而业界长期只公开汇总能耗，这份数据集补上了关键缺口。
items.why_en: Grid and data-center planning need sub-second power data, and by releasing traces where the industry publishes only aggregates, this dataset fills a critical gap.

items.title_zh: Soei：为多智能体 AI 软件工程提供“证据与意图”的结构化可观测性
items.title_en: Soei: Structured Observability of Evidence and Intent for Multi-Agent AI Software Engineering
items.summary_zh: AI 编程智能体已能长时间、多步骤、跨会话地完成软件工作且几乎无人监督。当开发者回头审视这些工作时，真正有用的问题不是“模型说了什么”，而是“实际做了什么、由谁做的、是否完成”。论文分三部分研究这一问题，其中首先核验了开源本地可观测性工具 Agenttrail 在 commit e4ba2da 上的源码：九个文档化的常量与机制在文件与行级别成立，但存在两条事件流水线始终未统一、Map 服务缺少鉴权等问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39468v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding agents now do long, multi-step and multi-session software work with little supervision. When a developer comes back to that work, the useful question is not what the model said but what was actually done, by whom, and whether it is finished. We study this in three parts. First, we verify Agenttrail, an open-source local observability tool for coding agents, against its source at commit e4ba2da: nine documented constants and mechanisms hold at file-and-line level, two event pipelines are never unified, and its Map service has an unauth…
items.why_zh: 当智能体自主工作成为常态，“可审计的过程记录”比对话日志更能决定人类能否信任并接管这些工作。
items.why_en: As autonomous agent work becomes routine, auditable process records—not chat logs—will determine whether humans can trust and take over that work.

items.title_zh: 红队测试非洲低资源语言：约鲁巴语与尼日利亚皮钦语的安全缺口
items.title_en: Red-Teaming Large Language Models in Low-Resource African Languages: A Case Study of Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin
items.summary_zh: 随着大模型在非洲快速普及，其低资源语言安全性却几乎未被测试，因为多数红队工作聚焦英语。本研究用 400 条明确的对抗性提示，覆盖四类危害，评估六款最先进大模型在约鲁巴语和尼日利亚皮钦语下的表现，并由母语标注者打分、用 Cohen's κ 评估一致性。结果显示：某些模型对英语提示的拒绝率最高可达 69%，但在约鲁巴语下拒绝率低至 0%，且原因并非模型“更愿意配合”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39590v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become more widespread in Africa, their safety in low-resource languages remains largely untested since most red-teaming work focuses on English. This study evaluates six state-of-the-art LLMs using 400 explicit adversarial prompts in Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, categorised into four harm categories. The responses were scored by native-speaker annotators and reliability was assessed using Cohen's $\kappa$. While models that rejected up to 69% of English prompts rejected as few as 0% in Yoruba, this was not becaus…
items.why_zh: 安全对齐若只在英语上生效，语言切换就成了绕过防护的捷径，直接影响数亿新用户。
items.why_en: If safety alignment only holds in English, switching languages becomes a shortcut around safeguards for hundreds of millions of new users.

items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型在3D推理上究竟差在哪？
items.title_en: Where Do Vision Language Models Fail at 3D Reasoning?
items.summary_zh: 研究指出，视觉语言模型常能答对单个判断，却难以稳定还原并使用一个3D物体的确切属性。为刻画这一差距，作者提出 BedBench——一个由13个程序化生成任务组成的受控基准，既考查单项判断也考查组合答案。测试覆盖12个开源权重模型和4个前沿模型，其中“按颜色计数”任务暴露出明显短板：人类准确率93.3%，最好的模型仅7.2%。针对性微调可把一个模型的准确率从3.0%提升到68.6%，说明该缺陷部分可通过训练改善。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.39639v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models can get individual judgments right while struggling to recover and consistently use the exact properties of a 3D object. To characterize this gap, we introduce BedBench, a controlled benchmark of thirteen procedurally generated tasks spanning individual judgments and composite answers. Across twelve open-weight and four frontier models, per-color counting exposes a pronounced weakness: humans achieve 93.3% accuracy, compared with 7.2% for the best model. Targeted fine-tuning raises one model's accuracy from 3.0% to 68.6%,…
items.why_zh: 它用一个可复现的受控基准量化了多模态模型在3D属性绑定上的系统性缺陷，并证明微调可部分修复。
items.why_en: It quantifies a systematic 3D property-binding failure in multimodal models with a reproducible benchmark, and shows fine-tuning can partially fix it.

items.title_zh: MuQ-Eval：开源的单样本AI音乐生成质量指标
items.title_en: MuQ-Eval: An Open-Source Per-Sample Quality Metric for AI Music Generation Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 现有音乐生成评测依赖 Fréchet Audio Distance 等分布型指标，它们无法给单条音频打分，且与人类判断相关性差；而唯一达到高人类相关性的单样本学习型指标又是闭源的。为此研究者提出 MUQ-EVAL：在冻结的 MuQ-310M 特征之上训练轻量预测头，训练数据 MusicEval 收录了来自31个文本生音乐系统的生成片段及专家质量评分。其中最简单的模型仅用冻结特征加注意力池化即可工作，为社区提供了可复现、可及的单样本音乐质量评估方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.22677v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Distributional metrics such as Fr\'echet Audio Distance cannot score individual music clips and correlate poorly with human judgments, while the only per-sample learned metric achieving high human correlation is closed-source. We introduce MUQ-EVAL, an open-source per-sample quality metric for AIgenerated music built by training lightweight prediction heads on frozen MuQ-310M features using MusicEval, a dataset of generated clips from 31 text-to-music systems with expert quality ratings. Our simplest model, frozen features with attention pool…
items.why_zh: 它填补了AI音乐评测中“开源且单样本”指标的空白，让研究者能在无参考音频时逐条评估生成质量。
items.why_en: It fills the gap for an open-source, per-sample metric, letting researchers score individual generated clips rather than only distributions.

items.title_zh: 上下文变了却还用旧值：LLM的“过期绑定”失败
items.title_en: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
items.summary_zh: 当偏好、目标和事实随时间变化时，LLM 智能体需要采用当前状态，而旧版本仍留在上下文中，模型却可能给出同一变量的旧值——作者将这种失败称为“过期绑定”（stale binding）。为研究模型何时、为何使用过时信息，他们提出 Controlled In-Context Memory（CICM）基准，用于在对话和智能体日志中追踪并使用更新后的信息。实验显示，即便是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态；在开源模型中，探针（probes）仍能……（摘要在此截断），提示内部表征中或仍保留可用线索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38866v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can stil…
items.why_zh: 它把“记忆更新失败”这一智能体落地中的关键隐患定义成可测问题，并提供了诊断基准。
items.why_en: It defines and benchmarks a key reliability failure for deployed agents: using outdated values even when the update is in context.

items.title_zh: MedGemma 对 GPT-4：开源与专有模型的零样本医学图像疾病分类比较
items.title_en: MedGemma vs GPT-4: Open-Source and Proprietary Zero-shot Medical Disease Classification from Images
items.summary_zh: 多模态大模型正以临床知识解读影像，成为疾病分类的新范式。本研究对比了两种架构路线：专用开源智能体 MedGemma 与专有大模型 GPT-4，任务是从图像中零样本诊断六种疾病。其中 MedGemma-4b-it 使用低秩适配（LoRA）微调后表现更优（原文摘要在此截断）。该工作为“专用小模型 vs 通用大模型”在医学影像场景的取舍提供了直接的实证参照。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.23304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce an emerging paradigm for medical imaging by interpreting scans through the lens of extensive clinical knowledge, offering a transformative approach to disease classification. This study presents a critical comparison between two fundamentally different AI architectures: the specialized open-source agent MedGemma and the proprietary large multimodal model GPT-4 for diagnosing six different diseases. The MedGemma-4b-it model, fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), demonstrated superi…
items.why_zh: 它直接检验了可本地部署的开源专用模型能否在医学影像任务上胜过通用闭源大模型。
items.why_en: It tests whether a deployable, specialized open-source model can beat a general proprietary model on medical imaging tasks.

items.title_zh: 从批量到流式：面向连续控制的深度强化学习新算法
items.title_en: Towards Batch-to-Streaming Deep Reinforcement Learning for Continuous Control
items.summary_zh: 当前最强的深度强化学习在连续控制任务上表现优异，但依赖经验回放缓冲、批量更新和目标网络，计算开销常与资源受限硬件不相容。新兴的流式深度强化学习范式通过纯在线更新绕开这些依赖，并在标准基准上取得不错效果。本文提出两种新的流式深度强化学习算法（摘要在此截断），试图在保持性能的同时降低对内存和算力的要求，使强化学习更易部署到边缘设备。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.08588v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: State-of-the-art deep reinforcement learning (RL) methods have achieved remarkable performance in continuous control tasks, yet their computational complexity is often incompatible with the constraints of resource-limited hardware, due to their reliance on replay buffers, batch updates, and target networks. The emerging paradigm of streaming deep RL addresses this limitation through purely online updates, achieving strong empirical performance on standard benchmarks. In this work, we propose two novel streaming deep RL algorithms, Strea…
items.why_zh: 它把强化学习从“重回放、重批量”推向纯在线更新，为边缘与低资源设备上的连续控制部署铺路。
items.why_en: It moves RL toward purely online updates, making continuous control more viable on edge and resource-constrained hardware.

items.title_zh: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark：评测心电图解读中的临床推理能力
items.title_en: ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark: A Benchmark for Evaluating Clinical Reasoning Capabilities in ECG Interpretation
items.summary_zh: 多模态大模型在心电图自动解读上表现亮眼，但它们究竟在逐步推理，还是仅依赖表层视觉线索，仍不清楚。为此研究者提出 ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark：一个包含6400余条样本的多轮评估框架，系统考查模型在17种核心心电图诊断上的分步推理能力。对当前先进模型的综合评测显示，它们在执行多步推理时存在系统性不足（摘要在此截断），提示“答对结论”未必等于“推理正确”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.14326v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promising performance in automated electrocardiogram interpretation, it remains unclear whether they perform actual step-by-step reasoning or just rely on superficial visual cues. To investigate this, we introduce ECG-Reasoning-Benchmark, a novel multi-turn evaluation framework comprising over 6,400 samples to systematically assess step- by-step reasoning across 17 core ECG diagnoses. Our comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models reveals a systematic shortfall in executing mu…
items.why_zh: 它把医学多模态模型的评测从“答案对不对”推进到“推理过程对不对”，对临床可信度评估至关重要。
items.why_en: It shifts medical multimodal evaluation from answer accuracy to the validity of the reasoning chain, which matters for clinical trust.

items.title_zh: 多智能体LLM驱动的贝叶斯优化自适应采集
items.title_en: Multi-Agent LLMs for Adaptive Acquisition in Bayesian Optimization
items.summary_zh: 探索与利用的权衡是序贯决策和黑箱优化的核心，但大模型如何推理并管理这一权衡仍缺乏理解。与贝叶斯优化中通过采集函数显式编码探索/利用不同，基于大模型的优化依赖对历史评估的隐式提示推理，搜索行为难以分析或控制。本文对LLM中介的优化过程开展指标层面的研究（摘要在此截断），尝试让多智能体以自适应方式参与采集决策，从而提升可解释性与可控性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.28959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The exploration-exploitation trade-off is central to sequential decision-making and black-box optimization, yet how Large Language Models (LLMs) reason about and manage this trade-off remains poorly understood. Unlike Bayesian Optimization, where exploration and exploitation are explicitly encoded through acquisition functions, LLM-based optimization relies on implicit, prompt-based reasoning over historical evaluations, making search behavior difficult to analyze or control. In this work, we present a metric-level study of LLM-mediated…
items.why_zh: 它试图把大模型的隐式搜索行为变得可度量、可控制，是LLM参与优化决策的重要一步。
items.why_en: It makes LLM-driven search behavior measurable and controllable, an important step for LLMs in optimization decision-making.

items.title_zh: LLM解码中的功耗封顶幻象：分阶段能耗分析
items.title_en: The Illusion of Power Capping in LLM Decode: A Phase-Aware Energy Characterisation Across Attention Architectures
items.summary_zh: 功耗封顶是LLM服务中常用的GPU节能手段，看起来也有效：设定上限后，GPU报告的功耗低于上限，能耗预算得以满足。但研究显示，对LLM服务中占主导的自回归解码阶段，封顶几乎不起作用。作者在NVIDIA H200上通过vLLM eager模式测试了四种注意力架构（GQA、MLA、Gated DeltaNet、Mamba2），发现解码内核在等待HBM、内核启动间隙GPU处于空闲，解码功耗不到700W额定值的一半，吞吐变化仅在几个百分点之内。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.11999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Power capping is a common GPU energy lever in LLM serving, and it appears to work: the cap is set, the GPU reports drawing less than it, and the energy budget is met. We show the cap does little for the phase that dominates LLM serving: autoregressive decode. Across four attention paradigms (GQA, MLA, Gated DeltaNet, and Mamba2) on an NVIDIA H200 under vLLM eager execution, decode kernels wait on HBM and the GPU idles between kernel launches, so decode draws less than half of the GPU's 700W rating and throughput stays within a few perce…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了以功耗上限做能效管理的盲区：真正的瓶颈在内存等待与启动间隙，而非功耗墙。
items.why_en: It exposes a blind spot in power-cap-based energy management: the real bottleneck is memory waiting and launch gaps, not the power wall.

items.title_zh: 用强化学习改进基于大语言模型的建筑法规自动合规系统
items.title_en: Reinforcement learning to improve large language model-based automated code compliance systems
items.summary_zh: 一篇发表于 arXiv 的论文（编号 2606.22402v2）指出，基于大语言模型（LLM）的建筑法规自动合规（ACC）方法容易生成错误甚至虚构的、机器可处理的规则。为此，作者提出 P4IR 两阶段框架：先用监督微调（SFT）向 LLM 注入领域知识，再用组相对策略优化（GRPO）强化学习提升所生成中间表示的准确性，这些中间表示以高层代码骨架的形式呈现。结果显示，该框架在相应指标上最终最多降低 21.3% 与 41.0% 的误差（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.22402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based approaches for automated code compliance (ACC) of building regulations are prone to generating incorrect and hallucinated computer-processable rules. This paper introduces P4IR, a two-stage framework that uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to instill domain knowledge in an LLM, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to improve the accuracy of the generated intermediate representations in the form of high-level code skeletons. The framework achieved final reductions of up to 21.3% and 41.0%…
items.why_zh: 它展示了强化学习如何补足 LLM 在专业法规领域“输出可执行规则”时的可靠性短板，对建筑等强监管行业的自动化落地有直接参考价值。
items.why_en: It shows how reinforcement learning can shore up LLM reliability when producing executable rules in a specialized regulatory domain, offering a concrete path to automation in heavily regulated industries like construction.

items.title_zh: BITEM 团队在 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务：用智能体 RAG 流程信号预测置信度
items.title_en: BITEM at the NTCIR-19 R2C2 Task: Predicting Confidence from Agentic RAG Pipeline Signals
items.summary_zh: BITEM 团队用一个统一的智能体式流程参加了 NTCIR-19 R2C2 任务的两个子任务。在该流程中，模型在一个电影语料库上搜索、阅读并记录证据，由调度器保存记录并裁定哪些内容可以提交。只有经过蕴含级联校验、与所引用段落核对通过的论断才会被接纳；只有背后有足够多已核验证据支撑时才会给出答案。每个问题会运行三到四次，每一轮都从剔除了此前轮次已用内容的语料中检索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.37993v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The BITEM team entered both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 R2C2 task with a single agentic pipeline, in which a model searches, reads and records evidence over a movie corpus while an orchestrator holds the record and rules on what may be submitted. A claim is admitted only once an entailment cascade has checked it against the passage it cites, and an answer is released only once enough checked evidence stands behind it. Each question is run three or four times, every pass retrieving from a corpus stripped of what the earlier passes have alre…
items.why_zh: 它提供了一种用证据核验与多轮检索来提升 RAG 系统答案可信度、并预测置信度的工程范式，对减少检索增强生成的幻觉有借鉴意义。
items.why_en: It offers an engineering pattern for making retrieval-augmented generation answers more trustworthy—and for predicting confidence—through evidence verification and repeated retrieval, which is useful for curbing hallucinations.
